# phonedriver

> phonedriver is an open-source MCP server and CLI that lets AI agents like Claude Code see and control Android and iOS phones.

phonedriver returns the screen as numbered text and, after each tap, type or swipe, only the lines that changed. It is one Rust binary under AGPL-3.0-only. It sends no telemetry. Speed figures are measured on an Android emulator; no physical Android phone has been measured.

## Start here

- [README](README.md): definition, speed and token numbers, install, FAQ
